title: Short title: a topic title for the start of a vertical short, as a brief full-frame card or a lower-area overlay (never a quote)

title.description: A plain topic title written from the clip. Never the speaker's own words.

show.description: Show name, printed once in small capitals

mode.description: card = opaque full-frame title screen (about 1.3 s, the clip starts after it); overlay = lower-area panel over the clip (about 2 s, no extra time)

bottom.description: overlay only: where the panel's bottom edge sits, as a fraction of the canvas height (kept above the captions and clear of the platform UI zone)
